name: web-lavender-travel-landing-on-desktop-monitor-mockup
title: Travel Landing Page on Desktop Monitor
whatItIs: A silver monitor on a white desk against a dark slate backdrop showing a lavender travel landing page with a circled word in the headline, store buttons, a stats card, a phone preview and a flight card.
whatItMeans: The dark backdrop makes the pale interface glow, and the studio desk gives a clean, premium presentation.
techniques: Dark to light split between backdrop and desk
Pale gradient page that contrasts with the dark scene
Hand-drawn ellipse around a headline word
Small floating cards around a centre phone
Dual store-download buttons under the headline
bestFor: Travel and consumer app landing pages

vocabulary.definition: A device on a clean desk with controlled lighting.
A word ringed with a hand-drawn ellipse.
Small cards and phone previews grouped around a hero.
